selectionGuide.description: A split image contrasts a muscular Doge with a small Cheems to exaggerate decline between stronger and weaker versions.
bestFor: then-versus-now comparisons framed as a decline
an idealized predecessor contrasted with a diminished successor
powerful and weak versions of the same role, product, or behavior
avoidWhen: the two sides are meant to be neutrally equivalent
the preferred side cannot plausibly occupy the dominant buff role
the joke needs a narrative sequence rather than a two-side contrast

mechanics.visual: The extreme difference in body size and posture encodes a built-in hierarchy between the imposing left side and frail right side.
mechanics.text: Use buff for the strong or idealized version and cheems for the weak or degraded version, keeping both labels structurally parallel.
